claims.statement: Fillout was publicly available by August 12, 2022.
Fillout supports forms, scheduling, payments, PDF generation, workflows, logic, and integrations.
Free includes unlimited forms and seats with 1,000 responses monthly. Annual prices are $15 monthly for Starter, $40 for Pro, and $75 for Business.
Fast setup, an approachable builder, strong conditional logic, and deep Airtable and Notion links are the clearest positive themes.
The free plan and responsive support receive repeated praise.
A smaller group describes pricing, support, payments, formatting, or missing-feature problems.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The builder and free plan make a real trial easy, but complex logic and updates still need edge-case tests.
scoreRationale.product: Strong general form builder, especially when Airtable or Notion is the record behind it.
scoreRationale.billing: No seat charges and a generous free tier; branding, analytics, partial responses, custom domain, and high response volume can force higher plans.
scoreRationale.overall: Fillout is easy to recommend for a real form trial. Build the failure paths and database updates before replacing a live intake process.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Generous free features sit beside paid gates for branding, analytics, partial responses, and custom domains.
Support is commonly praised while isolated cases describe a difficult dispute.
